about: Special campaign days of the special summary revisions with 1 January 2027 as the qualifying date, on which booth level officers sit at the polling stations to take claims and objections. The Commission's letter of 15 October 2026 left the days to each Chief Electoral Officer. Two readings, 13 November 2026.

days.source: CEO Goa, press note No.4-1-2026/ELEC/2852 of 11.11.2026
days.quote: During the Specials Camps to be held on 28/11/2026 & 29/11/2026 (Saturday & Sunday) and 05/12/2026 & 06/12/2026 (Saturday & Sunday), the concerned BLO will be available on the polling booth for acceptance of the forms.

days.source: CEO Uttarakhand, minutes of the meeting with recognised parties of 22.10.2026, No.1899/XXV-31/2026 of 23.10.2026
days.quote: विशेष संक्षिप्त पुनरीक्षण के दौरान पात्र नागरिकों के पंजीकरण को बढ़ावा देने हेतु दिनांक 21 नवम्बर एवं 28 नवम्बर, 2026 को विशेष अभियान दिवस निर्धारित किए गए हैं।

days.source: CEO Andaman and Nicobar Islands, press release of 12.11.2026, printed in The Daily Telegrams, 13.11.2026
days.quote: During the claims and objections period, special camps will be conducted at all Polling Stations of Andaman & Nicobar Islands Parliamentary Constituency on 21st November, 2026 (Saturday) and 22nd November, 2026 (Sunday) from 9 AM to 5 PM. Booth Level Officers (BLOs) will be available at their respective polling stations on these days to assist electors.

days.source: News On AIR, 12.11.2026, reporting what the Chief Electoral Officer said
days.quote: Special camps will be conducted on the 21st ,22nd and 29th of this month at the designated locations where electoral rolls will be available and electors can check their details and include their names in the required forms at the Centre itself.

days.source: The South First, 12.11.2026, reporting the District Election Officer of Puducherry
days.quote: Special camps will be conducted on 21, 22, 28 and 29 November to facilitate applications for inclusion, deletion and correction of voter details.
Special campaign dates have been scheduled for November 21, November 22, December 5 and December 6, while the last date for disposal of claims and objections is December 28.

days.source: Mediasaheb, 12.11.2026, report of the Chief Electoral Officer's meeting with recognised parties
days.quote: इसके लिए 21 एवं 22 नवंबर तथा 5 एवं 6 दिसंबर को विशेष अभियान आयोजित किए जाएंगे।
पहले चरण में 21 एवं 22 नवंबर तथा दूसरे चरण में पांच एवं छह दिसंबर को अभियान चलेगा. इन तिथियों पर संबंधित मतदान केंद्रों पर बूथ लेवल ऑफिसर (बीएलओ) सभी आवश्यक प्रपत्रों के साथ मौजूद रहेंगे.

days.source: Patrika, Unnao, 07.11.2026, quoting the Deputy District Election Officer
days.quote: जिले की सभी छह विधानसभा निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों के समस्त 2648 मतदेय स्थलों पर 21 नवंबर शनिवार, 22 नवंबर रविवार, 28 नवंबर शनिवार एवं 29 नवंबर रविवार को विशेष कैंप आयोजित किए जाएंगे।
